name: fold
title: Fold
description: useFoldFeatures() hook: iPhone Duo / Android foldable hinge state. Null-safe require of expo-hinge — returns null fields on non-fold devices and when the peer dep is absent, so consumers short-circuit back to pre-fold behavior.
docs: AniUI is React Native. On an existing RNR/NativeWind project, add and use directly — the tokens and aliases already match, no setup needed. On a fresh project, run `npx @aniui/cli init` first to configure NativeWind/Uniwind, theme tokens, and Metro/Babel.
